# External measured datasets

Raw measured datasets are not bundled in this Git repository.

## Silica polymerization experimental data

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8324851
- Source file: `SupplementaryData_SilicaPolymerization.xlsx`
- Raw SHA-256: `6e8d65f177305e1bc95b5effb2124bc1f32af94422a66454c1918bf3785226dc`
- Scope: monomeric silica concentration versus time with temperature, pH, and ionic strength for 61 usable experiments.

Review the current source terms before redistribution. Preserve the original workbook and author citation.
